title: Resolved Issues become institutional learning: a terminal demand carries a learning or NONE_DECLARED, enforced by repo
objective: Enforce the doctrine's last clause: a demand in a terminal status (RESOLVED/REJECTED) must carry a `learning` (docs/learnings/<slug>.md or NONE_DECLARED); repo refuses silence.
business_value: The doctrine said 'every resolved Issue becomes potential institutional learning' and nothing read a resolved demand; learnings lived only in session memory outside the repo.
in_scope: docs/learnings/README.md + entries for the terminal demands
out_of_scope: auto-resolving AUTHORIZED demands when their Issues close (the reconciliation-shaped gap; a later WP)
a network check of Issue state
acceptance_criteria: a RESOLVED or REJECTED demand without learning is refused by repo naming it
NONE_DECLARED accepted; a nonexistent learning path refused; a malformed learning refused
every shipped terminal demand carries a valid learning
mutation kills; compose green both shapes

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design. Carries its own G07 self-dossier. Closes the last of the original doctrine's discovered gaps.
